gta.title: GTA V · Letter-scrap starter route
gta.scope: Story Mode; 12 of 50 letter scraps; source numbering preserved. Not GTA Online.
gta.notice: Coordinate overview — no roads or terrain. Use the detailed source map for navigation. Source-reviewed, not playtested.

markers.name: Boarded-up house
markers.description: Enter the abandoned wooden house from the rear.

markers.name: Roadside restroom
markers.description: Look beside the male-restroom entrance.

markers.name: Protest campsite
markers.description: Check the entrance of the bannered white tent.

markers.name: Crop tunnels
markers.description: Search midway through the second left tunnel downhill.

markers.name: Lighthouse
markers.description: Climb the base steps and search behind the lighthouse.

markers.name: Lakeside house
markers.description: Look outside the red door beside the boat frame.

markers.name: Abandoned motel
markers.description: Search the empty swimming pool.

markers.name: Runway rocks
markers.description: Climb the three-level rock beside the runway.

markers.name: Circular construction
markers.description: Check the central grating in the circular structure.

markers.name: Coastal cavern
markers.description: Reach the sandy area inside the cavern by water.

markers.name: Small island
markers.description: Search the rocks on the island’s north side.

markers.name: VINEWOOD sign
markers.description: Climb to the top of the letter I.
